profile.headline: Tech Lead | Senior Software Engineer | .NET Core 8 | Angular | Full Stack Developer | 18+ Years Experience | Scalable Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
Results-driven Senior Software Engineer and aspiring Tech Lead with over 18 years of experience designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications.
 
Specialized in .NET Core 8, Angular, TypeScript, and SQL Server, with strong expertise in building high-performance, data-intensive applications. Proven track record of modernizing legacy systems, optimizing performance, and implementing robust, maintainable architectures.

Strong focus on UI/UX design and front-end architecture, with hands-on experience creating intuitive, responsive, and user-centric interfaces using Angular, JavaScript, Kendo UI, and modern web technologies. Adept at translating business requirements into seamless user experiences that enhance usability, accessibility, and overall product quality.

Experienced in leading development initiatives, mentoring team members, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business goals.
 
 Key strengths include:
 • Designing scalable RESTful APIs and distributed systems
 • Driving performance optimization and code quality improvements
 • Implementing CI/CD pipelines and Agile methodologies
 • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills in complex environments

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and supported enterprise UDCOps applications and REST APIs used by OLED research, manufacturing, quality, and testing teams.

Work as a technical lead by partnering with business users, coordinating offshore developers, reviewing code, and helping move projects from design through production deployment.

Migrated multiple UDCOps applications from .NET Core 2.1 to .NET 10, updating legacy components, resolving compatibility issues, and improving performance, security, and maintainability.

Implemented Roles & Permissions features, including RBAC, Row-Level Security, project-based access control, audit logging, and project-sharing capabilities.
Page 2

Played a key role in moving business-critical UDCOps applications from on-premises servers to Microsoft Azure, working with infrastructure, networking, and security teams to prepare the environments and support production rollout.

Helped design and implement the AKS deployment platform, containerizing applications with Docker and using GitOps to support consistent deployments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production.

Built and supported Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows, troubleshooting AKS deployments, networking, authentication, certificates, and Azure SQL Managed Instance connectivity during the migration.


Optimized SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions, and indexes to improve application response times and support more reliable business workflows.
Used GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT to assist with development, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design.
Environment: .NET Core 2.1, .NET 10, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, Entity Framework, SQL Server 2022, Azure SQL Managed Instance, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, SignalR, Kendo UI, SpreadJS, JavaScript, jQuery, Microsoft Azure, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, Azure DevOps, Git, TeamCity, CI/CD, Postman, MS Test.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · JavaScript Libraries · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in analyzing data,designing and developing Web Applications using ASP.NET,C#  and VB
•	Build web application into 3 tier architecture by creating BAL,DAL & UI layers 
•	Develop CSS and JavaScript,  Jquery  files which help to maintain website design and client side validation.
•	All the user interface layers, web pages are created and integrated to maintain the performance of data flow and data integrity using ASP.NET User Controls, Entity Framework, LINQ,Ajax Toolkit Control, Theme, Innovative Toolkit, Web Server Controls.

•	Developed SQL stored procedures,SSIS Packages to interact with the databases.

 •	Developed Console Applications for generating Data Feed file for clients.

•	Developed Window application for processing payroll file & enrollment file.


•	Developed Crystal Reports.

positions.title: .Net developer
positions.description:
Group buying edge is the industry leader in uniting independent and small restaurant chain with manufacturers. GBE manages rebate and coupon information between restaurant and Manufacturers. GBE has thousands of Sysco Manufacturers and restaurants. GBE has their own intranet application for maintaining all rebate information and product information for the program. 
Responsibilities:
•	Involved in analyzing data and developing Web Forms using ASP.NET and C#.
•	All the user interface layers, web pages were created and integrated to maintain the performance of data flow and data integrity using ASP.NET User Controls, Web Server Controls, Telerik Control and LINQ.
•	Used built in validation controls and custom validation controls for front end validations.
•	Involved in the design of product comparable modules that were used to make product comparable pairs. 
•	Implemented Telerik Reports to retrieve various accounts, manufacturers, and restaurant information.
•	Made Changes related to Performance of GBE Intranet system using the n tier architecture developed in .NET Framework.
•	Developed SQL stored procedures to interact with the databases.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
•	As a developer involved in design and developing Web Forms using ASP.NET,C# and VB.
•	Manage user Authentication and Authorization.
•	Write Core logic for Business Model.
•	All the user interface layers, web pages are created and integrated to maintain the performance of data flow and data integrity using ASP.NET user controls, Web Server Controls and ADO.NET. 
•	Used built-in validation controls and custom validation control for front-end validations.
•	Implemented the Triple-DES Algorithm in .NET to encrypt and decrypt E-mails.
•	Generate script for importing babycity’s products on various web portals like Amazon, E-bay, Shop.com, E-directory for selling.
•	Generate script for creation of Froogle Feed file for submitting product on Google base.
•	Involved in Requirements gathering.
